name: PossessedWolf
identity: Lean dark olive wolf with amber eyes, sharp gold dorsal spines, shaggy cheeks, four broad clawed paws, and one long smooth upward-curving tail with dark pointed tuft. Preserve scars and mane shape shown in source.
reference_review: Viewed source prefab and atlas: long rear tail, upright shaggy ears, spines, no collar, four dark paws. Face includes large upper fangs and amber eyes; no extra saddle.
